app.name: Pulse Assessment
app.description: Scores coverage, utilization and adoption across 11 Dynatrace capabilities.

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Grail bucket access for DQL metrics queries

scopes.name: davis-copilot:conversations:execute
scopes.comment: Dynatrace Intelligence answers and the Smart Report

scopes.name: settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: Read configuration: anomaly detectors, log pipelines, classic SLOs, masking and privacy settings

scopes.name: slo:slos:read
scopes.comment: Count SLOs created in the Service-Level Objectives app (criterion SLOs defined)

scopes.name: storage:security.events:read
scopes.comment: Security findings (vulnerabilities, detections, compliance) live in security.events

scopes.name: app-engine:apps:run
scopes.comment: Read installed app names from the registry for the adoption view

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Read Smartscape nodes and edges, so the assessment works on environments without the classic entity model

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: Read the estate target the team set for this environment

scopes.name: state:app-states:write
scopes.comment: Save the estate target (hosts, applications, clusters planned)
